failedGpxUrls.disposition: Not a blocker after this QA pass because official Naturvardsverket BD21 linework is available as preferred master geometry; keep Naturkartan page/API as corroboration only.

naturkartanGpxSpotCheck.conclusion: Naturkartan GPX availability is good for most referenced routes but inconsistent and sometimes contradicted by publish_gpx metadata. Use as secondary corroboration or fallback, not as the uniform master source.

geometryPolicyDecisions.decision: Use official Naturvardsverket/Lansstyrelsen state-trail linework (Leder.geojson/WFS/REST) as primary master geometry wherever a matching summer hiking feature exists. Use Naturkartan GPX/API as official-presented corroboration or fallback. Use OSM/Waymarked only for QA, gap detection, side-route clues, or fallback where official geometry is absent and source policy allows it.

Research files should now treat the selected master geometry as high-quality planning-grade. Do not call it final navigation-grade until the runtime importer applies source/licensing approval, coordinate transformation, clipping/splitting, simplification, endpoint snapping, connector modeling and QA overlays.

geometryPolicyDecisions.caveat: Endpoint snapping at huts, portals and villages
geometryPolicyDecisions.decision: Use route-line coordinates for route geometry and model huts, Naturum, trail portals, bus stops, village services and parking as endpoint/access/facility metadata. Do not bend the main route line to a hut centroid, bus stop or village service unless the official route line does so. If a hut is 20-300 m from the through-line, model a hut-spur/access connector or endpoint zone in normalization.

geometryPolicyDecisions.caveat: Combined official features spanning multiple sections
geometryPolicyDecisions.decision: Split official features at researched section boundaries rather than importing long grouped lines: BD31 into sections 3-4, BD77 into sections 13-14, BD78 into sections 15-17, BD88/AC20 into sections 19-21, AC16 into sections 22-24 and AC3 into sections 26-27.

Normalize every section to official section order. Reverse source geometries when stored opposite official order, especially Naturkartan/GPX lines and AC16/AC2/AC3 sublines where noted in section files.

geometryPolicyDecisions.caveat: Boat, rowboat, ferry and road transfer geometry
geometryPolicyDecisions.decision: Represent boat/rowboat/ferry/road gaps as typed connectors, not as hiking geometry and not as arbitrary straight hiking lines. Where official water-line features exist in Leder.geojson (BD50, BD77, BD78), keep their lower geometry quality and transport type. Where no official water line exists, keep operator/landing metadata and mark geometry as connector-pending.

Suppress side-route linework from the main Kungsleden section geometry unless the app has an explicit alternate/connector model. This applies to Singi-Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta, Norra Sytertoppen AC8, Hemavan AC9/AC10/Drottningleden/Lapplandsleden/Fjallfinakatan and local lift/gondola access routes.

Currentness caveats are not geometry-quality blockers. They must remain as import/publication checks for bridge closures, fire bans, weather, hut seasons, boat/bus timetables, reindeer/hunting/fishing and protected-area notices.
